// Positive control (#5170): a `statSync` inside a `try` whose `catch` answers a literal `false` — the
// same collapse of "absent" and "could not examine" that `fs.existsSync` has, written by hand.
import fs from 'node:fs';

export function isDirectory(target: string): boolean {
  try {
    return fs.statSync(target).isDirectory();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
